guidedHelp.title: Guided help
guidedHelp.disclaimer: Scripted guidance, not a live AI conversation. It only helps you find the right report. It never files anything for you.
guidedHelp.intro: Tell me what happened, or choose the option closest to it below.

options.money: Money was taken from my account
options.harassment: Someone is harassing or threatening me

replies.money: That's financial fraud. I'll take you to the money-loss report. It takes about 90 seconds and starts by asking what happened, in your own words.
replies.harassment: I'm sorry that's happening. I'll take you to the harassment/threats report so you can tell us what's going on.
replies.hacked: Let's get that reported. I'll take you to the account-compromise report.
replies.unsure: That's okay. You don't have to know the exact category. Start with a report and describe what happened in your own words; we'll help sort out the rest.

guidedHelp.freeTextPrefix: Based on what you typed, this sounds closest to: "{option}".

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.body: We couldn't load this page. Try again, or call 1930 if this is urgent and you'd rather not wait.

errorSummaryTitle: Please fix the following before continuing:
notAnFir: Your Complaint ID is a record that you reported this. It is not an FIR (First Information Report). An FIR is a separate, later step that a police officer registers if the case warrants it.
